description: This file defines the MockSSPILibrary class used for unit testing SSPI library calls on Windows, including methods for handling security credentials and contexts, and expectations for security package info queries.

classes.name: MockSSPILibrary
classes.description: A mock implementation of SSPILibrary for unit testing, allowing expectations to be set for security package info queries and managing active credentials and contexts.

methods.name: MockSSPILibrary
methods.description: Constructor for MockSSPILibrary, initializes with a package name.

methods.name: ExpectQuerySecurityPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets an expectation for a call to QuerySecurityPackageInfo with specified response code and package info.
